task_title: Theme-equipment review: generate/regenerate labels, gate thumbs on generation, run-status strip, non-disruptive review

plan_review.notes: Changes 7-10. 0 blocking, 5 major all resolved: (1) run-status setId correlation via workflow run-name + distinct available/errorKind states; (2) two projections hasPhaseOutput vs validatePhaseArtifactsForUpVote never conflated; (3) variant-approval stays pipeline-only, awaiting-generation until approved-variant; (4) polling guards (timeout, single-inflight, set+ref fence, requery node); (5) roster hasPhaseOutput=true (entry is the output). Minors: reviewStatus active-tab-only, itemCard-only gating (not shared reviewButtons), invariant tests, databaseId int validation + rel=noreferrer.

rounds.notes: Changes 7-10. 2 Medium findings, both fixed with regression tests. Finding 1: draftFeedback keyed only by raw item id + collection sentinel -> collection draft leaked across set-switch and an item id literally collection collided with the set-level box; fixed with scope-namespaced feedbackKey(scope,id) cleared in openSet+loadIndex but not load(). Finding 2: run-status correlation suffix-spoofable; fixed with anchored setId-escaped regex.

Changes 11-16 (renderer status UX + judge null-rationale + run-active control lock). 1 Medium finding: the active-run banner reported live progress but review controls stayed enabled during an in-flight run, so a mid-run verdict/bulk/advance/brief mutation would either fail the runner final atomic CAS save (all ~30min paid vision work discarded) or silently overwrite the maintainer change, and the banner count would drift. Fix: gate every durable-state mutation on isRunActive() (review thumbs incl. the shared brief Save-and-Approve up-button, bulk Approve remaining, Advance); run-phase/refresh/back stay enabled; a visible lock note explains why; the run-status poll re-renders (not just patches the strip) on an active<->inactive transition so controls actually lock/unlock, and a broken poll never leaves them stuck locked. Regression guard test added. Live-verified [disabled] controls + lock note against real in-progress run 30345704005.
